target_fidelity.note: It is a past, active, negative declarative with no modal.

naturalness.note: Staying home yesterday coherently supports not walking to the park.

pedagogical_suitability.note: It provides focused practice of past simple negation with familiar language.

determinacy.note: The cue and context allow other valid completions, such as adding “yesterday,” while the accepted set is limited to two exact phrasings.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: The vocabulary and context are common and transparent.

no_answer_leakage.note: The prompt gives only the base-form cue, not the completed negative form.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: Solving it requires only basic past simple negation.

no_world_knowledge.note: No external or specialist knowledge is needed.
